availability_boundary: 第五次総合計画後期基本計画は2026年度が最終年度で、FY2027開始の第六次総合計画が策定中。現行進捗、FY2026予算、次期計画案をversion/time boundaryで分離する。
quality_boundary: This Phase 14 inventory verifies Nagano's final-year latter basic plan, FY2024 progress-reporting route, FY2027 next-plan transition, FY2026 budget, and FY2024 settlement. Draft next-plan content and municipal indicator progress are not promoted into current achievement, causal attribution, or cross-city comparison judgments.
